newsitem.title: NIGER: Four killed in attack on Niger customs post.
newsitem.headline: Four killed in attack on Niger customs post.

text.p: Two policemen and two customs officers were killed in an attack on an eastern customs' post in Niger, national radio reported on Wednesday.

The radio said unidentified armed attackers hit the customs' post on Monday night at N'Guigui on the border with Chad, 1,500 km (900 miles) east of Niamey, the capital of the impoverished West African state.
N'Guigui is a bastion of ethnic Toubou rebels who signed a peace treaty in April 1995.
